Question Choices: Find the distance between -5 and 8 using absolute value. Fill in the blanks: The subtraction expression inside the absolute value is |-5 - 8| = |___|, so the distance is ___.
Hints: Distance = absolute value of the difference. The difference may be negative, but distance cannot be.
Solution: |-5 - 8| = |-13| = 13. The same formula applies whether the positions are on the same or opposite sides of zero. Exact check: -5-8 = -13; abs(-5-8) = 13.

Question Choices: Two towns are located at -18 km and -6 km on a straight road. What is the distance between them? Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Distance = absolute value of the difference. The difference may be negative, but distance cannot be.
Solution: |-18 - (-6)| = |-12| = 12. The same formula applies whether the positions are on the same or opposite sides of zero. Exact check: abs(-18-(-6)) = 12.
